selection_rationale: CPU-only NEURON+pymoo NSGA-II workload (no GPU needed). Selected offer 31639237: AMD EPYC 7B13 64-core (cpu_cores_effective=64), 252 GB host RAM (503 GB visible inside container), 25 GB container disk, $0.2382/hr (dph_total) in Norway (reliability 0.9964, ~406-day duration, cuda_max_good=13.1). This is the SAME offer/host (machine_id 55891, public IP 141.0.85.200) that t0080 used and validated; architecturally identical EPYC 7B13 with proven per-cell wall-clock of ~43 s/cell at 64 sequential cores. Of three EPYC 7B13 offers with reliability>=0.99 in today's search, this is the only 64-core option (the others are 51-core 36034856 with reliability 0.9913 below threshold and 43-core 33850061 at $0.2940/hr). Cheaper Xeon E5/E7 v4 alternatives at $0.10-$0.16/hr have ~1.5x lower per-core NEURON throughput than EPYC 7B13, which would push wall-clock past 12-15 h and net SAME or HIGHER total cost while taking longer. Projected total: ~10.0 h instance lifetime * $0.2382/hr = $2.38, within $3.00 hard cap and $2.50 effective envelope. Underlying base rate is $0.2290/hr (gpuCostPerHour) plus $0.0116/hr storage = $0.2382 dph_total observed in instance details.
